race.comment: Good little clash between two talented mares. The unbeaten TENNESSEE BOUND (2) is race fit, dropping back to 1100m last time when setting slow fractions in front was against but she was still good enough to win as the $1.45 favourite. The market loves her and up to 1300m where she can roll along a bit more should suit better. GOLD COAST BELLE (7) resumes. She's won her past three and is yet to miss the quinella. Capped off a fantastic preparation with victory in the Bendigo Guineas and gets weight off the danger despite giving away fitness. They're very hard to split. Of the others, CARBONADOS (1) won well beating subsequent winner Althoff last time at Rosehill and that looks solid form, respecting. While PIASTRI (4) has claims with a favourable set up today.
